repo.description:
### Impact                                                                   

Sites using the discourse-patreon plugin with API v2 credentials could grant group membership to free Patreon members who are not entitled to patron benefits.

This affects sites where a Discourse group is mapped to the virtual "All Patrons" reward. If that group grants access to restricted content, affected members could read that content, including private categories and topics.
                                                                             
### Workarounds                                                              

Until the fix is applied, administrators can remove the affected groups’ permissions to private content. Access for legitimate patrons can instead be granted through a separate group whose membership is managed manually.

Disabling the Patreon plugin alone does not revoke group memberships already granted.
repo.summary: Free Patreon members may gain access to All Patrons-restricted groups
